summary.text: Dan Rogers is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Steve Green (R) and Unaffiliated candidate Calvin Larson Jr.
According to his campaign website, he is a science teacher, logger and third-generation farmer in Hubbard County.

paragraphs.text: Rogers's campaign website says he lives with his wife, Cynthia, on the Hubbard County family farm where he grew up.
It describes him as a science teacher, father, grandfather, logger, third-generation farmer and community leader.
On his campaign website Rogers says he wants to make child care accessible and affordable, invest in education from infancy, and advocate for rural Minnesota and family farms.

sources.title: Dan Rogers for MN Senate District 2
